patches.summary: Sort map keys before hashing in cacheKey to produce a deterministic cache key.
patches.reason: Go map iteration is randomized; multi-param requests produced different keys on every call, making the 5-minute response cache always miss.

patches.summary: Guard ListIDs against SQL injection by validating resourceType via sqlite_master before interpolating into a table-name position.
patches.reason: resourceType was passed directly into fmt.Sprintf as a table name with no sanitization; a crafted value could escape the SELECT context.

patches.summary: Guard ResolveByName against SQL injection by validating matchFields entries against ^[a-zA-Z0-9_]+$ before interpolating into the json_extract path.
patches.reason: field was interpolated directly into the json_extract path expression; a crafted value like name')) OR 1=1-- could break out of the json_extract context.

patches.summary: Project equityResponse items to the flat shape novel analysis commands query before storing in writeThroughCache.
patches.reason: NSE India equity quote responses wrap data under 'equityResponse' with nested fields; writeThroughCache only handled 'results'/'data'/'items'/'id' envelopes so equity data was never persisted, causing all eight novel commands to always return empty results.
patches.validated_outcome: After running equity quote, SELECT from resources WHERE resource_type='equity' returns rows keyed symbol_YYYYMMDD with correct symbol, lastPrice, deliveryToTradedQty, varMargin, extremeLossMargin, and metadata.preOpenMarket.IEP fields. delivery-spike returns spike signals after 2+ sessions.

patches.summary: Fix resolveLocal to look up equity snapshots by symbol param rather than URL path segment.
patches.reason: The generic fallback extracted the last URL path segment (GetQuoteApi) as the store ID, but equity rows are keyed symbol_YYYYMMDD — offline fallback always returned not-found even when cached data existed.
patches.validated_outcome: equity quote --symbol RELIANCE --data-source local returns cached snapshot with source=local.

patches.summary: Pre-reserve the next request slot under the lock in AdaptiveLimiter.Wait so concurrent workers see monotonically advancing lastRequest.
patches.reason: Wait released the mutex before sleeping, letting concurrent sync workers all read the same lastRequest, sleep the same duration, and fire simultaneously — defeating the per-second rate limit.

patches.summary: Replace public-library import paths with local module path nse-india-pp-cli/internal/... in data_source.go, client.go, and novel command files.
patches.reason: Local copy had imports referencing github.com/mvanhorn/printing-press-library/.../nse-india/internal/... but go.mod declares module nse-india-pp-cli — module mismatch prevented local builds entirely.

patches.summary: Migrate indices commands to NSE's new indexTrackerApi and allIndices endpoints; add auth login/status/logout; add indices data and indices all commands.
patches.reason: /api/equity-stockIndices now returns 404 — NSE migrated to /api/NextApi/apiClient/indexTrackerApi. New endpoints work with bm_sv cookie only (no full session required for allIndices). Added BrowserCookie to config and Cookie header injection in client.
patches.validated_outcome: indices all --category sectoral returns 21 sectoral indices live. indices data --index 'NIFTY 50' returns peRatio=20.79, pbRatio=3.18, dividendYield=1.36. indices constituents --index 'NIFTY 50' returns 50 stocks sorted by weightage with HDFCBANK=10.9% at top.

patches.summary: Fix movers command to use 'volume'/'value' as the index param instead of the dead 'INTRADAY' default; manually unwrap the {data:[...],timestamp} envelope.
patches.reason: NSE's live-analysis-most-active-securities endpoint uses index=volume or index=value — not INTRADAY. The old default returned HTTP 200 with empty data. Response also has no 'status' field so extractResponseData didn't unwrap it.
patches.validated_outcome: movers returns 20 items sorted by volume (IDEA first); movers --by value returns 20 items sorted by traded value (VEDL first).

patches.summary: Replace dead /api/search/autocomplete endpoint with NSE archives EQUITY_L.csv fetch + client-side substring search.
patches.reason: /api/search/autocomplete is completely removed from NSE India. The NSE archives publish EQUITY_L.csv with all 2372 listed equity symbols + company names + ISIN — sufficient for symbol discovery.
patches.validated_outcome: symbol-lookup --query RELIANCE returns 8+ matches including RELIANCE with ISIN INE002A01018; symbol-lookup --query INFOSYS returns INFY (Infosys Limited).

patches.summary: Remove --function-name flag from equity quote and derivatives; hardcode the NSE API internal routing parameter.
patches.reason: functionName is an NSE internal routing parameter (getSymbolData / getSymbolDerivativesData) that users should never change. Exposing it as a flag caused live dogfood to inject 'example-resource', returning HTTP 400 from NSE.
patches.validated_outcome: equity quote --symbol RELIANCE returns live price data. Dogfood no longer injects --function-name.

patches.summary: Return [] (valid JSON array) instead of human text when --json is set and local store has no data for novel analysis commands.
patches.reason: Live dogfood json_fidelity tests run commands with --json; output_mismatch failures occurred because empty-store paths printed human-readable 'No data found' messages instead of [].
patches.validated_outcome: json_fidelity dogfood tests pass for novel commands when store is empty.

patches.summary: Write normalised constituent rows to resource_type='index_constituents' after indices constituents fetches, and update index-driver SQL to query that resource_type with camelCase field names.
patches.reason: writeThroughCache only persists items with an 'id' field; indexTrackerApi constituent items have no 'id', so nothing was stored. Additionally the old SQL used field names from the dead equity-stockIndices shape ($.meta.indexName, $.index) which don't match the normalised fields from the new endpoint ($.indexName, $.pChange). Result: index-driver silently returned empty results after running indices constituents.
patches.validated_outcome: After running 'indices constituents --index NIFTY 50', resource_type='index_constituents' rows are populated keyed by symbol_indexName with camelCase fields. index-driver --index 'NIFTY 50' returns weighted contributions for 50 stocks.
